diagram_previews.alt: A circle with centre O, the regular hexagon inscribed in it (blue) and the regular hexagon circumscribed about it (red, touching the circle at the blue vertices). One triangle from O to a side of the inscribed hexagon is shaded, with its apothem drawn dashed and labelled h_n; a red dashed radius to a point of tangency is labelled r.
